title: Bridgewell Comfort Care Member Repair Discount Rules
content:
Members of the HVAC Maintenance Agreements receive member pricing on repairs they pay for to a network HVAC contractor, on the following rules.

## Rules

1. A member repair discount is applied only while the agreement status is active. The status is read from the company's agreement record.
2. On a repair the member pays for to a network HVAC contractor, the invoice is reduced by the level's member repair discount rate, rounded to the cent and limited to the level's maximum member discount on one repair invoice. The discount on an invoice is the lower of two amounts: the invoice amount before discount multiplied by the discount rate and rounded to the cent, and the level's maximum discount per repair invoice.
3. The diagnostic fee on a member repair call is the level's member diagnostic fee, overtime charges are waived when the level waives after-hours overtime charges, and the call is scheduled within the level's priority scheduling hours.
4. The discount applies only to the amount the member pays: it never applies to a repair paid under a Bridgewell home warranty contract, never to the home warranty service call fee, and never to a repair by a contractor outside the network.
5. One discount is applied per repair invoice.

## When the discount applies

| Agreement status active | Repair by a network HVAC contractor | Amount paid by the member (not under a Bridgewell home warranty contract, not the home warranty service call fee) | Member repair discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Applied, once for the invoice |
| No | any | any | Not applied |
| any | No | any | Not applied |
| any | any | No | Not applied |

## Worked invoices (hypothetical figures)

The rates and maximums below are chosen for illustration.

| Discount rate | Maximum per invoice | Invoice before discount | Rate applied, rounded to the cent | Discount applied | Amount after discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10% | 250.00 | 1,800.00 | 180.00 | 180.00 | 1,620.00 |
| 10% | 250.00 | 2,500.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 | 2,250.00 |
| 10% | 250.00 | 3,400.00 | 340.00 | 250.00 (limited to the maximum) | 3,150.00 |
| 15% | 400.00 | 1,234.55 | 185.18 (from 185.1825) | 185.18 | 1,049.37 |

In each row the rate acts on the invoice amount before discount, the result is rounded to the cent, and only then is it compared with the maximum per invoice.

## Points of judgement

- A repair invoice already paid under a Bridgewell home warranty contract carries no member repair discount, whatever the agreement level.
- The home warranty service call fee is never reduced by the member repair discount.
- A repair carried out by a contractor outside the network carries no member repair discount.
- An invoice receives one discount only; a second discount is not applied to the same repair invoice.
